notes: v2.9.26 - Extension health diagnostics + Athena window protection. The Extension Health screen (Settings -> Integrations) can now read deep diagnostics straight from the extension: granted permissions, watchdog alarms, athenaOne tab state including tabs Chrome's Memory Saver has silently unloaded, platform, and worker uptime - each red row with a safe fix. Also new: the Athena window guard - on Mac, maintenance window moves can no longer yank a fullscreen athenaOne out of its Space or park it off-screen after a display change, and athenaOne tabs are marked keep-active so Memory Saver cannot discard the signed-in tab (which previously forced a fresh login). Reads and writes are unchanged from v2.9.25's verified flow.
